purpose: Selection of 60 Lichess puzzles for v0.2.1 production packs (20 per level, 2 chapters x 10). Committed so the drafts can be regenerated on any machine without session context.
howToRegenerate: 3. Author texts into tools/var/import-texts.json (key = lichessId), then: node tools/import-lichess.mjs author
4. node tools/import-lichess.mjs merge  (writes content/puzzles/*.json and runs the validator)
notes: Solver side = opposite of FEN side-to-move; FEN holds the position before the setup move (setup = opponent's move, sanLine[0]).
task.type is decided by the actual end of the line (mate -> MATE, otherwise WIN), not by the chapter.
capture-queen chapter uses userPlies [1, 2]: all 1-ply candidates were mate finals, so 2-ply queen captures were taken (all WIN).
IDs are assigned by merge: per level in PLAN_ORDER (mate-in-1 -> nov-001..010, capture-queen -> nov-011..020, etc.), sorted by rating within a chapter.
finishChecklist: Author RU/EN texts for all 60 into tools/var/import-texts.json: title (short), prompt (one phrase, no spoilers), hints tier1 idea without naming the piece / tier2 names the piece / tier3 names the move, explanation 2-4 sentences (>= 40 chars). Check facts with node tools/replay.mjs "<ids>" <pool>.
node tools/import-lichess.mjs author (validates sidecar) then node tools/import-lichess.mjs merge (writes content/puzzles/novice|professional|grandmaster.json + runs validate-content.mjs).

Docs: docs/CHANGELOG.md (v0.2.1), docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md (KI-003 -> 60 puzzles, KI-008 -> resolved), README.md (version badge, puzzle counter), content/README.md, content/puzzles/README.md, docs/development/CONTENT_AUTHORING.md, and replace remaining '4 demo puzzles' mentions in docs (USER_GUIDE, GETTING_STARTED, ARCHITECTURE, qa/*).

Gates: node tools/check-docs.mjs && node tools/validate-content.mjs && JAVA_HOME=<jdk21> ./gradlew :core:test :app:assembleDebug :app:lintDebug (JAVA_HOME is machine-specific; this machine used D:\Dev\jdk-21.0.12.1+1).
Verify assets/content/*.json exist inside app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk, delete any temp files, then commit 'release: v0.2.1' and push.
